# E8 QUARANTINE: every fit, threshold and selection in this file is made on E3-E7 only; E8 rows are ONE labeled blind read and were never an input to any choice.

# The causal arrival policy family, run on models TRAINED AND CALIBRATED FOR THE ARRIVAL DECISION rather than for within-cell ordering.  Every row is strictly causal: the decision at arrival j reads only arrivals <= j.
# THE FAMILY IS A SEARCH and carries its search-adjusted luck bar: the identical family on shuffled scores, arrival times preserved, best-of taken as the bar.

# THE DENOMINATOR IS THE CAUSAL ORACLE (E3 $2,348 / E4 $2,133 / E5 $2,021 / E6 $2,675 / E7 $3,360), not the full-hindsight DP ceiling: an arrival-time rule may not be asked to capture a fraction of a bound allowed to see the whole day.  aims = 0.80 x the causal oracle; the hindsight ceiling rides beside it as context only.
# ANY ROW HERE THAT READS NEGATIVE IS THE HONEST BASELINE, not a losing arm to file away: it is what this formulation actually earns at the arrival second, and it is reported as such.
